objective: Find and cite payment records in archived payment history that are part of a confirmed fraud incident.

params.marking_discovery: SELECT DISTINCT payment_status, three_ds_status FROM payment_transactions WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = 1
params.fraud_criteria: Read /docs/payments/3ds.md to determine the criteria that flag a payment as fraudulent (e.g., specific payment_status and three_ds_status values)
params.fraud_records: SELECT record_path, payment_id, payment_status, three_ds_status FROM payment_transactions WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = 1 AND payment_status IN (<discovered fraud statuses>) AND three_ds_status IN (<discovered fraud 3ds statuses>)
params.fraud_record_paths: list of record_path values from the selected fraud payment records
